findings.title: GPL-2.0 CRC routine statically linked into proprietary firmware
findings.description: A GPL-2.0 file is compiled into the single firmware image.
findings.impact: Distribution of the firmware would require releasing the whole image's source under GPL-2.0.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a permissively licensed or in-house CRC implementation.

findings.title: Highcharts requires a commercial licence for this use
findings.description: Highcharts is free only for personal and non-profit use.
findings.impact: Commercial distribution without a licence breaches the vendor's terms.
findings.recommendation: Buy a licence or switch to a permissively licensed chart library.
